agent_coverage.interpretation: Abstentions remain full-coverage misses where applicable; answered-subset accuracy is not the headline.

t6.interpretation: Directional evidence only; nine pairs cannot satisfy the frozen 20-pair bar.

cost_efficiency.limitation: Runs used ChatGPT authentication rather than metered API billing; no token price or dollar cost is inferred.

anti_gaming.interpretation: The registered features do not distinguish the exactly balanced probe. The all-zero fit collapses to an all-drift prevalence baseline; F1 0.8768 is not evidence of a strong attacker and is not a pass/fail floor.

establishes: a frozen version-conditioned COBOL regulatory-drift task with 196 aligned test rows
reviewer-auditable provenance, exclusions, leakage controls, and evidence-linked labels
reproducible full-coverage, locus, class, temporal-pair, faithfulness, calibration, and paired-comparison measurements
null evidence that the six registered surface features do not distinguish the balanced T2.2 probe
does_not_establish: practical utility in production mainframe compliance workflows
detector superiority or that the current agent solves the task
novelty merely because evaluated systems perform poorly
a formal T6 bar result from nine pairs

detector_finding.statement: The frozen agent significantly underperforms RAG+reranker on interprocedural T1 F1 and has low full-coverage performance.
detector_finding.coverage_context: The agent answered 42/196 and abstained on 154/196. Its 0.9048 answered accuracy must not be reported without the 0.2143 answer rate and full-coverage F1 0.3665.
detector_finding.supported_error_interaction: Frozen trajectories categorize 93 agent outcomes as coverage/abstention failures and 61 as insufficient evidence; 25 rows have evidence-verification failures, 22/42 answered rows have localization failures, and 31/36 interprocedural rows fail. These categories may overlap and do not license unsupported causal claims.

threats_to_validity.name: synthetic_real_composition
threats_to_validity.statement: The 196-row test set mixes 153 synthetic and 43 real-curated rows; results do not isolate performance on a broad natural-code population.

threats_to_validity.name: real_curated_sample
threats_to_validity.statement: Only 43 of 51 reviewed real-curated candidates entered v1; eight were excluded under the frozen fail-closed adjudication protocol.

threats_to_validity.name: regulatory_scope
threats_to_validity.statement: The benchmark is limited to pinned RBI card/debit-card and KYC/AML clauses and their selected historical versions.

threats_to_validity.name: cobol_corpus_diversity
threats_to_validity.statement: The evaluated COBOL corpus is dominated by AWS CardDemo-derived and repository-native programs; IBM CICS CBSA is not consumed by benchmark v1.

threats_to_validity.name: materialized_context
threats_to_validity.statement: Systems consume reconstructed/materialized source bundles rather than an unrestricted production mainframe environment.

threats_to_validity.name: ci_fragile_strata
threats_to_validity.statement: Several class-by-locus cells contain fewer than ten rows; their point estimates do not support broad comparative claims.

threats_to_validity.name: temporal_pair_dependence
threats_to_validity.statement: T6 rows are paired by byte-identical code locus across clause versions and therefore are not independent single-row observations.

threats_to_validity.name: t6_pair_count
threats_to_validity.statement: Only nine intact T6 pairs remain, below the declared minimum of twenty for evaluating the formal reporting bar.

threats_to_validity.name: annotation_workflow
threats_to_validity.statement: Real-curated labels use one human-primary pass, a separate Claude verification pass, and human final review; agreement is not inter-human agreement.

threats_to_validity.name: model_provider_identity
threats_to_validity.statement: Provider-backed findings are specific to ChatGPT-authenticated gpt-5.6-luna and the recorded prompts, budgets, and verifier.

threats_to_validity.name: mixed_projection_provenance
threats_to_validity.statement: Agent, RAG+reranker, and oracle-slice projections mix reused M4 rows with targeted Phase-5 reruns and are descriptive comparisons, not controlled prompt/effort ablations.

threats_to_validity.name: agent_coverage
threats_to_validity.statement: The agent answered 42/196 rows and abstained on 154/196, so answered-subset accuracy cannot stand in for full-coverage performance.

threats_to_validity.name: drift_prevalence
threats_to_validity.statement: The test set is drift-heavy (153/196), inflating raw binary F1 for all-drift predictors and making balanced accuracy essential context.

threats_to_validity.name: track_b_crlf_manifest
threats_to_validity.statement: Track B's benchmark manifest still records stale CRLF split hashes; Phase-5 uses the ratified canonical LF identities without editing the Track B artifact.

m5_decision.reason: T5.1-T5.5 preserve a valid frozen benchmark, an evaluable negative headline result, complete audit/provenance evidence, and explicit limitations. Closing records the measurement and does not require an agent GO.
m5_decision.next_track_c_task: T7.5 paper and submission package; final completion still depends on T7.2/T7.3 release artifacts.
